summary: Animation-node dispatch with a skip flag. First calls sub_54B570(this, a2, 0) and caches its result in v4. Unless the skip byte at this+0x3C has bit 4 set, walks the animation-node linked list rooted at *(this+0x204) through each node's next pointer (i[4]); for every node it reads the flags dword (i[5]), clears bits 0x20000028 when v4 is non-zero, and when the pre-mask flags lack bit 0x200000 dispatches an update through SceneNodeStateUpdateWithTransform when the node capability field (i[79]) is non-zero, otherwise through sub_556B10.

operations.description: result = sub_54B570(this, a2, 0); the value is cached in v4 and controls later flag clearing.
When (*(BYTE*)(this + 0x3C) & 4) != 0, skip the entire dispatch loop and return; otherwise process the list.
Walk the linked list starting at *(this+0x204); advance with i = i[4] (next pointer) until null.
Read node flags (i[5]); when v4 is non-zero, rewrite them as flags & 0xDFFFFFD7, clearing bits 0x20000028.
When (flags & 0x200000) == 0, dispatch the node update; otherwise leave the node untouched.
When the node capability field (i[79]) is non-zero, result = SceneNodeStateUpdateWithTransform(a2, i); otherwise result = sub_556B10(a2, i).
Return the final result (last assigned node update result, or the initial sub_54B570 result when the list was skipped).
